assumptions: sizes N = 1..6; laws with a restricted spectrum are re-run for N = 7, 8
SAT conflict budget 2,000,000 per instance; UNKNOWN is recorded, never guessed
laws are taken up to renaming of variables (left side normalised to x(yz) or (xy)z)
meta.falsification: Any law other than x(yz) = (xy)(xz) with a spectrum strictly between {1} and {1..6}.
meta.hypothesis: H-C06-2 (bold): every such law other than left-distributivity has anchored spectrum {1} or {1,...,6}; a restricted non-trivial spectrum is special to LD.
meta.methodology: Enumerate right sides (2 shapes x 6 labelings for 3 leaves, 5 shapes x 36 surjective labelings for 4 leaves), drop t equal to the left side, solve MagmaSAT(N, law, anchor) for N = 1..6, classify spectra, extend restricted ones to N = 8.
meta.question: Among all laws whose left side is x(yz) or (xy)z and whose right side is any term with 3 or 4 leaves using exactly the variables x, y, z, which admit a successor-anchored model (x*0 = x+1 mod N) for which N <= 6?
meta.title: Anchored spectra of all laws x(yz) = t and (xy)z = t with t of 3-4 leaves over {x,y,z}

summary: 382 laws: all N <= 6: 77, trivial only: 283, restricted: 22
